requirements.summary: Add a first-launch onboarding modal that auto-opens once per browser and shows the existing in-app Gumroad/Etsy upload instructions.
acceptanceCriteria: On first app load in a fresh browser profile, an onboarding modal opens automatically without requiring navigation to the Export screen.
The modal content is in English and reuses the existing instructions content (the same guidance users can see in the app) rather than introducing conflicting steps.
Closing the modal persists a local flag (e.g., localStorage) so the modal does not auto-open again on subsequent visits in the same browser.
The modal can be dismissed via a clearly labeled Close button; pressing Escape also closes it (standard dialog behavior).

file_operations.description: Create a controlled modal using existing shadcn/ui Dialog primitives that renders the existing ExportInstructions component inside the dialog content; include a clearly labeled Close button and ensure onOpenChange supports Escape-to-close behavior (persisting the local 'seen' flag when dismissed). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a small state hook that reads/writes a localStorage 'seen' flag and exposes helpers for (a) checking whether auto-open is allowed, (b) opening/closing the modal, and (c) marking the modal as dismissed without resetting the flag on manual opens.

Wire the onboarding modal into the app shell so it can auto-open on first eligible app load; reuse ExportInstructions by rendering the new OnboardingInstructionsModal at the top level (inside AppLayout) and persist the 'seen' flag only when the modal is dismissed.

requirements.summary: Prevent the onboarding modal from displaying while ProfileSetupDialog is required; show onboarding only after profile setup completes (if not previously dismissed).
acceptanceCriteria: When ProfileSetupDialog is open, the onboarding modal is not shown at the same time.
After profile setup completes, the onboarding modal appears if it has not been dismissed previously in that browser.

file_operations.description: Gate onboarding auto-open behind profile setup state: if showProfileSetup is true, keep onboarding closed; once profile setup completes (showProfileSetup transitions to false) and the 'seen' flag is not set, trigger onboarding modal open.
Add support for delaying/deferring the first auto-open until an external condition is met (e.g., profile setup no longer needed) without losing the ability to auto-open exactly once per browser.

requirements.summary: Add a persistent 'Instructions' control in the main UI to re-open the onboarding modal from both editor and export views without resetting the auto-open flag.
acceptanceCriteria: A user can re-open the onboarding modal from the main app UI at any time (both from the editor view and export view).
Re-opening the modal does not reset the 'seen' flag; the modal still does not auto-open on future app loads unless the user manually opens it.

file_operations.description: Add a persistent header button/link labeled "Instructions" that calls a provided callback to open the onboarding modal; ensure it is visible regardless of whether the user is in editor or export view. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Pass an "openInstructions" handler into AppLayout and connect it to the onboarding modal's open state so manual opens work from anywhere and do not change the local 'seen' flag.
Ensure the hook distinguishes manual open from dismissal persistence: manual re-open must not clear or reset the stored 'seen' flag.
